sloka: यत्नात् मृगयमाणः तु न आससाद वने प्रियाम् ।शोक रक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते ॥३-६०-१०॥
transliteration: yatnāt mṛgayamāṇaḥ tu na āsasāda vane priyām ।śoka rakta īkṣaṇaḥ śrīmān unmatta iva lakṣyate ॥3-60-10॥

translations.english: He ransacked the forest, yet did not find his beloved. He appeared like a mad man, his eyes turned red with tears of sorrow.
